task: 按材料直接写一篇 350–550 汉字公众号短文，面向第一次负责上线的工程师。主题是怎样让上线后的第一天可控；有明确可操作的判断，不先交提纲。
criteria: 用已知事件支撑一个判断和可执行动作
不捏造亲历、收入或他人心理
source_condition: same provided synthetic materials; no external retrieval
review_method: textual evidence against each frozen criterion; independent forward test recorded separately
acceptance: all criteria addressed; record limitations separately; never author aesthetic approval
